title: libpod: copy from image mount subpaths in created containers
body:
This PR fixes an issue with `podman cp` when using an image mount with a subpath.

The problem happens when the container is created but not started yet. The path was not resolved correctly in this case.
I changed the path handling to find the image mount correctly and resolve symlinks using the container path.
I also added tests for created, running and stopped containers.

Fixes: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29857
